conventions.EOS: EOS IDs248044/248046 included as output events; stop iff final EOS; length iff exact original cap and no EOS.
conventions.loading: One loaded process pair per category batch; loading/gates excluded from request timing.
conventions.prefill: Both MTP hidden-only; serial versus overlap; native label denotes historical ORDER SLOT only.
conventions.pressure: Mandatory 0.5s both-host sampled guard, not a continuous guarantee.
conventions.statistics: Two paired repeats descriptive, not CI/tail/general-workload guarantees.
conventions.timing: Rank0 inclusive first_token_seconds and wall_seconds; phases non-additive; no cross-host clock subtraction.
conventions.warmup: Two original short queue prompts cap32 per loaded batch; no first-long-shape exclusion.
